navigation.label: Updates & synchronization
navigation.description: Run registered update procedures through your trusted Mac connection.

introduction: Choose an update to check, synchronize or publish. You can keep working while it runs.
notice: Owner-only execution on your trusted Mac, locally or through your approved private connection. Your Mac must be awake. No browser shell commands, passwords or service-role credentials are used. Publication commits and pushes reviewed working changes in the selected repositories and registered dependencies.

confirmation.title: Review publication
confirmation.description: This will synchronize registered dependencies, validate, commit and push working changes in the selected repositories. Genuine conflicts stop publication.
confirmation.reviewed: I have reviewed the selected repositories and their working changes.

results.hosting: Changes were synchronized and submitted for publication. Live availability has not been checked.
results.noPublication: No changes were submitted for publication by this action.
results.connection: The update service is unavailable. The last known result is shown; an active update may still be running.
